title: 1882 Lofts - 402 - Downtown 2nd & Church
description:
Parking not included.  Prime downtown location on 2nd & Church.

Built in 1882 by the George A. Dickel Company.  

Private rooftop deck with panoramic views of downtown Nashville.  Custom welded spiral stairs, 75" TV in main room, 55" TVs in bedrooms,  curated outlaw country record collection.

Short walk to the Stadium, Lower Broadway & Printer's Alley

Guest access
Unit 402, it's all your's and has a private rooftop deck.

Other things to note
Units 401 & 402 are the only Lofts on the 4th floor, both are 2 king bedroom/2 bath, so if you have a larger group you can rent both and have the whole floor.

If you need more space the 3rd floor (units 301 & 302) also has two 2 bedroom/2 bath lofts.

If you like this style, please check out our lofts in our other building 3 blocks away, The Armstrong Corset Lofts.
